stackDivergence.rationale: Original CPPU plain/struct/enum factories, getDescription and complete getByName routing reuse the single live registry/common-prefix/atomic/string owners. Preserve lazy15 basic types, original two-unit sequence skip (including noncanonical [xlong), last ASCII :@ separator, bounded original o3tl conversion, derived-member success/failure acquisitions, typedef resolution, and acquired256-entry cache with eviction. Type factories preserve base/element/member/name ownership, original enum copies/defaults, polymorphic flags, recursive sequence layout and logical offsets. Original TYPELIB_DANGER_GET/RELEASE inline contracts remain in their header owner; the lookup implementation split respects the authored size limit. Logical UNO size/alignment values follow the verified selected LP64 model, not the physical layout or addresses of JS objects. Full unchanged SAL/CPPU owners and original generated headers are observed under normal and ASan/UBSan; native streams include complete initialized field/count/identity/default/offset witnesses, all65536 UTF16 units in reverse ASCII search, all256 signed-char bytes, original checked assertions and the explicitly synthetic zero-count reference guard. Native process assertions map to Error without claiming post-failure recovery. Full interface factories/completion/static_types/Type/Any/Reference/default RuntimeException/case service, actual threading/shutdown/physical ABI/JS malformed inputs and complete upstream consumer QA remain unfinished or unverified. Related original QA evidence is not execution of those full suites.
